meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以把一个文件夹、网址、笔记或刚才对话里的工作流程,整理成可复用的“技能”文件存下来;若同名技能已存在,它会读取并更新原文件,而不是覆盖。它只用 Claude 现有的读文件、搜索、抓网页等工具完成,不引入额外程序。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」「把这个做成技能」「改进/更新某技能」等,或给出目录、网址、粘贴的笔记让它提炼时触发。它只创建/更新技能,不安装现成技能。

say.text: /learn 读一下 docs 文件夹,把它做成技能
say.note: 它会扫描目录并生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: learn what we just did,把刚才的步骤存成技能
say.note: 它从对话中提炼流程并写入技能文件。

say.text: 更新 ssh 部署技能,加上刚才的报错处理
say.note: 它会读取原技能并就地改进。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current chat into a reusable skill file at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; if one exists, it updates it in place. It follows the project's skill guidelines and uses only built-in tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', etc., or asks to turn something into a skill, capture a workflow, or improve/update a named skill. Or with '/learn' plus a path, URL, or notes.

say_en.text: /learn read the docs folder and turn it into a skill
say_en.note: It scans the directory and generates SKILL.md.

say_en.text: learn what we just did and save the steps as a skill
say_en.note: It distills the conversation into a skill file.

say_en.text: update the ssh deploy skill with the error handling we found
say_en.note: It reads the existing skill and improves it in place.
